name: 06401 · Ansonia, CT
findings: ZIP 06401 (Ansonia) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06401 (Ansonia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06401 (Ansonia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
